purpose: Release evaluation for Meaning search over locations under L2-061.9. Deterministic acceptance fixtures (hand-built vectors) are separate and unchanged by this manifest; they never establish live relevance.

gate.rule: At least three of the first five results are relevant for at least six of the eight queries, and at least two are relevant for every query, judged against the pre-labeled relevant set by the named reviewer with recorded reasons.

corpus.requirement: Every location holds two to five images, a scouting brief without logistics detail, a saved report generated by the production scouting model, and a current vector before any query runs.
